page.title: Accessibility
page.intro: This system follows the Brazilian Electronic Government Accessibility Model (e-MAG) and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).
page.shortcutsIntro: The shortcuts below take you straight to the main areas of the page:
page.shortcutBrowsers: In Firefox use Alt + Shift + number; in Safari and Chrome on macOS use Control + Option + number.
page.contrastText: The "High contrast" button in the top bar switches to higher contrast colors. Your preference is saved in this browser.
page.fontText: Use the A+ and A- buttons in the top bar or the browser zoom (Ctrl + and Ctrl -). The layout adapts up to 200% zoom.
page.formsText: Required fields are marked with an asterisk. Errors are described in text next to each field and listed in a summary at the top of the form, with links to each field.
page.readersText: Pages use semantic markup (headings, landmarks and labels) compatible with screen readers such as NVDA, JAWS, Orca and VoiceOver.
